value.name: Joe raises gun at Miles
value.description: Joe aims his gun at Miles, escalating the confrontation to immediate lethal threat.
evidence: Joe is raising the gun at Miles.

value.name: Miles sprays Joe with Mace
value.description: Miles counters Joe's threat by spraying him with Mace.

value.name: Joe fires blindly
value.description: Blinded by the Mace, Joe fires his gun blindly while struggling to breathe.
evidence: BANG -- Joe fires blindly, scrunching his eyes against the chemical, sucking for breath like a jet engine revving for a take-off.

value.name: Marylin breaks Joe's nose
value.description: Marylin attacks Joe with an elbow to the face, breaking his nose.
evidence: SLAM -- Marylin elbows him in the face, breaking his nose.

value.name: Marylin kicks Joe in the groin
value.description: Marylin follows up with a hard groin kick that slows Joe down but fails to stop him.
evidence: She finishes with a solid groin kick. It slows him down, but doesn't stop him.

value.name: Joe keeps rampaging and firing
value.description: Joe stumbles but regains his footing and continues rampaging around the room while firing his gun.
evidence: Joe stumbles a bit, but regains his footing.
BANG -- Joe is rampaging around the room, still firing

value.name: Joe reaches for inhaler
value.description: While still firing, Joe pounds his chest and searches for his inhaler to relieve his breathing trouble.
evidence: thumping at his chest with his free hand for his inhaler.

value.name: Marylin runs to Miles
value.description: Marylin abandons the fight and runs to Miles as Joe continues shooting.

value.name: Miles and Marylin flee toward door
value.description: Miles takes Marylin's hand and they run toward the door, trying to escape Joe.
evidence: He takes her hand and they run toward the door, seeking egress.

value.name: Joe fumbles inhaler
value.description: Joe pulls out his inhaler but, while still firing, blindly drops or mishandles it.
evidence: BANG -- still firing, he pulls out the inhaler but blindly bobbles it.
